The muse tool writes <spec.id>-m<n>-color.png (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs lines 211 to 212), so the element run makes prop-hen-m1-color.png. In unit 1, the spec id prop-alligator-sheet gives prop-alligator-sheet-m1-color.png. The six hen rows would point to a file that no run makes (FR-3). The FR-3 test builds its output set from the same elements.json path, so it cannot see this. Fix: set the spec id to prop-hen-sheet (or change the path and the references to prop-hen-m1-color.png), and make the FR-3 test derive the output from the element spec id.
